emma: Heads-up: running a paid test to support the Apr 28 webinar. Objective: registrations (high intent) + build a retarget pool for Q2 nurture. Plan below.

-- Channels: Search (Google), Social (LinkedIn Sponsored Content), and Display retarget. Start soft Apr 25 10:00 PDT, end May 3 23:59 PDT.

-- Budgeting / pacing: 7-day initial experiment window. Total test budget $8,400 (avg $1,200/day). Pacing cadence: 25% day 0-1, 50% day 2-4, 100% day 5-7. Pause if CPA > $75 for 48h.

-- Bidding: Search: tCPA target $50 (brand + product intent grouped). Social: Maximize conversions w/ target CPA $65. Retarget display: CPM with dynamic creative optimization. Use conversion window 7d-view / 1d-click.

-- Creative strategy: two creative bundles: V1: Webinar invite (feature benefits + CTA), V2: Case-study/social proof (customer ROI). Each bundle has 3 sizes + 1 6s motion. Rotate creatives every 72h, auto-optimize by CTR -> keep top 40%. Include creative-level tracking via ?utm_content=V1_hero or V2_social. Creative IDs: V1-{101..103}, V2-{201..203}.

-- Landing pages: canonical webinar page (deep content) + lite-calendar LP for paid social (short form). A/B hero copy test: "Fast inference, predictable cost" vs "Reduce inference spend by 3x". GA4 tag + FB pixel + server-side GTM present. Event: webinar_register (send webinar_id).

-- Targeting: 
- Search keywords: top 30 intent keywords (list in the drive).
- Social: job titles (ML Eng, Platform Eng, ML Infrastructure), company size 50-2000
- Retarget: 14d site visitors + 30d engaged on product pages. Frequency cap 3 impressions/day.

-- Geo: primary US (scale), secondary EMEA (UK+DE+FR), CA as fallback. Use bid modifiers: US x1, UK x0.9, DE x0.85, CA x0.8.

-- Attribution & tracking: set UTM pattern utm_source=paid&utm_medium={search|social|display}&utm_campaign=web_apr28&utm_content={V1|V2}_{size}. Use click_id passthrough for server-side dedupe.

-- Lead routing: send all paid leads to HubSpot list "WB-Apr28-Paid". If lead.score >= 60 then auto-create opportunity + send to SDR queue. Sam will add CRM fields: model_interest / infra_budget_range / lead_source_ad_id.

-- KPIs & signals to roll: primary = cost per registration; secondary = demo requests, SQLs from paid cohort. Early stop: week1 CPA > $80 and CR < 2%.
